title: Finite coefficient model for a locally finitely presented module on an immersed stratum
statement: Let T be a topologically noetherian scheme, f:X→T an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and ℓ prime. For every locally finitely presented module M over f⁻¹Ω_T, there are a finite intermediate coefficient field E and a locally finitely presented f⁻¹E_T-module M_E with (f⁻¹Ω_T)⊗_(f⁻¹E_T)M_E ≅ M. Here Ω_T and E_T are the condensed coefficient rings of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and finite fields are [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set].

proof.text: The immersion identifies X with a subspace of the noetherian space T, hence X is noetherian and therefore qcqs. Apply simultaneous local matrix descent directly to the inverse-image coefficient cocone; no comparison with the standard coefficient rings on X is needed. Obtain a finite affine cover and matrices d_i at one field E whose extended cokernels give M locally.

Each cokernel of d_i is finitely presented by the defining finite presentation. Apply the local-model gluing theorem to these modules and their given extended identifications. Obtain F≥E, a global module P, its local comparisons and its scalar-extension isomorphism to M.

Extension of scalars is additive, preserves finite colimits, and sends the regular module to the regular module by the explicit bimodule right-unitor isomorphism. It therefore preserves finite presentations. Transport these through the local comparisons of P to conclude that the same cover witnesses local finite presentation of P. The finite-presentation transport uses the existing fp_iff_of_iso and fp_map helpers of BoundedConstructibleExtendScalars, now public; scalar extension uses its existing fp_extend helper. No duplicate helper proof is introduced.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_lfp_finiteCoefficient_model_on_immersion
    (T X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T]
    (f : X ⟶ T) [IsImmersion f] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)))
    (hM : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)) M) :
    ∃ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
      (M_E : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))),
      IsLocallyFinitelyPresented
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)) M_E ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E))).obj M_E ≅ M)
